intent: Help me correct my email address and password on the signup form.
actions: Start on /signup with a valid Full Name, an Email Address containing only its local part, and a revealed Password shorter than the required eight characters; both email and password have been blurred and show their validation errors.
Click Email Address, move the caret to the end, and append a valid domain suffix; pause with Email Address still focused.
Click Password, select its contents, and type a valid password of at least eight characters; pause with Password still focused without submitting the form.
